# The Oral History Is a Succession Document — motion and channel evidence manifest

## Reels / TikTok / Shorts
### 0–8s — OBJ-loc-gtfy-00717
Voiceover: One frame holds a named designer, a model, a photographer, a collection, and an institutional record—separate roles that public shorthand often compresses.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Bernard Gotfryd photograph collection, Library of Congress Prints and Photographs Division

### 8–16s — CN07-DIAGRAM-1
Voiceover: 01 · PREPARE — Who should speak and under what conditions?. Define purpose, interviewer, narrator, consent, accessibility, language, compensation, privacy, cultural authority, distress protocol, topics declined, recording ownership, and withdrawal limits.

Treatment: vertical reveal with source footer

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 16–24s — CN07-DIAGRAM-2
Voiceover: 02 · ELICIT — Which decisions cannot be read from files?. Ask for sensory thresholds, rejected options, relationship dynamics, exceptions, informal vocabulary, moments of uncertainty, and what the narrator does not know.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 24–32s — CN07-DIAGRAM-3
Voiceover: 03 · CORRECT — Can narrators revise the record?. Provide transcript, contextual notes, name and pronoun checks, redaction, embargo, restriction, disagreement, and approval choices without promising control the archive cannot legally grant.

Treatment: vertical reveal with source footer

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 32–40s — CN07-DIAGRAM-4
Voiceover: 04 · CONNECT — How does voice join the archive?. Bind recording, transcript, timecodes, people, objects, files, rights, access, preservation copies, migrations, and successor-use rules through stable identifiers.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 40–48s — S08
Voiceover: Personal Digital Archiving is retained as evidence, education, reporting or rights context.

Treatment: vertical reveal with source footer

Credit: Library of Congress

Rights: Link and quote narrowly; check each downloadable resource before redistribution.
